issuer: the Chiapas Secretaría de Finanzas (Subsecretaría de Ingresos), after the driving test before the traffic police
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Chiapas Secretaría de Finanzas's Subsecretaría de Ingresos pages of the driving licence (costs updated 6 January 2026, requirements updated 4 February 2026). A new licence is paid at the Finanzas offices after the driving test has been passed before the traffic staff. The costs for 2026 of a new automovilista licence: 1 year (foreigner) $864, 2 years $1,272, 3 years $1,330, 4 years $1,738, 5 years $2,088; minors of 16 to 18 get the automovilista licence for 1 year at $864, with a letter signed by the parent or guardian. The licence is therefore issued from 16 (the page names it the automovilista licence, not a permit; a reading to check, since under 18 it runs one year only); the fee held is the shortest term an adult citizen buys, 2 years at $1,272. The 1-year licence at $864 is the foreigner's and the minor's; the form holds no other term for a non-citizen, so it is said here, not held as a foreign fee. The fees' law (the Ley de Derechos del Estado de Chiapas) wasn't read: haciendachiapas.gob.mx's other host didn't answer. No identity card and no exchange list are held.
